page.overview:
Who is Coiren Saeldain?

Coiren Saeldain is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is plump and stately. She has a billowing voice.

She is notoriously pompous, bombastic and self-important. She has a mannerism that makes it sound as if she is making speeches or pronouncements every time she speaks. She is, nevertheless, no fool.

Coiren is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
